children: Wolters Kluwer, a global leader in professional information, software solutions and services, today announced that
IFFCO Tokio General Insurance Company Limited

, a leading general insurance provider in India, has selected CCH® Tagetik to support Ind AS 117 (IFRS 17) compliance disclosure reporting requirements, and broader finance transformation initiatives.

This initiative comes as India's insurance sector prepares for the adoption of Ind AS 117, the country's insurance contracts accounting standard aligned with IFRS 17. The standard is intended to improve transparency, comparability, and governance across insurers.
A unified platform for compliance and performance

IFFCO Tokio will implement CCH Tagetik as a single, integrated platform covering Ind AS 117, Ind AS 116, disclosures, and financial reporting. This will replace fragmented reporting processes with a connected framework that improves data accuracy, transparency, and governance.

IFFCO Tokio selected CCH Tagetik to provide a structured and consistent approach to financial data and reporting across multiple regulatory requirements. The unified platform will help streamline disclosures and strengthen reporting accuracy across Ind AS requirements.
With CCH Tagetik, IFFCO Tokio will:
Ensure
compliant Ind AS 117 and Ind AS 116 reporting
through an integrated framework
Streamline
disclosure and regulatory reporting processes
within a single system
Strengthen
data consistency, governance, and audit readiness
Establish a
reliable and unified data foundation
for financial reporting
Enable finance teams to focus on
analysis and reporting efficiency
“As insurers address increasingly complex reporting needs, the ability to bring multiple standards onto a single platform becomes essential,” said
Nishant Vyas, General Manager of CCH Tagetik India at Wolters Kluwer
. “We are pleased to support IFFCO Tokio with a solution that strengthens transparency, simplifies disclosures, and enhances financial governance.”

CCH Tagetik is a corporate performance management platform that helps organizations address regulatory reporting requirements while connecting planning, consolidation, and financial performance management on a single platform.
About Wolters Kluwer
Wolters Kluwer (

) is a global leader in information solutions, software and services for professionals in healthcare; tax and accounting; financial and corporate compliance; legal and regulatory; corporate performance and ESG. We help our customers make critical decisions every day by providing expert solutions that combine deep domain knowledge with technology and services.

Wolters Kluwer reported 2025 annual revenues of €6.1 billion. The group serves customers in over 180 countries, maintains operations in over 40 countries, and employs approximately 21,100 people worldwide. The company is headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands.

Wolters Kluwer shares are listed on Euronext Amsterdam (WKL) and are included in the AEX and Euronext 100 indices. Wolters Kluwer has a sponsored Level 1 American Depositary Receipt (ADR) program. The ADRs are traded on the over-the-counter market in the U.S. (WTKWY).
